source.title: Sergey Ryabko wins European Rubik's Cube Championship 2010
source.content:
[Sergey Ryabko](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009RYAB01) won the [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2010](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2010) with an average of 10.31 seconds. [Erik Akkersdijk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005AKKE01) finished second (10.38) and [Cornelius Dieckmann](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009DIEC01) finished third (10.78).  
 World records: Bálint Bodor Megaminx 47.53 (single) 51.45 (average), Brúnó Bereczki Pyraminx 2.65 (single).  
 European records: Maarten Smit Rubik's Clock 6.63 (single) 7.88 (average), Michal Halczuk 5x5 Cube 1:15.28 (average), Rafal Guzewicz 3x3 multi blind 11/11 in 55:10.

translation.title: Sergey Ryabko 夺得 2010 年欧洲魔方锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Sergey Ryabko](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009RYAB01)以 10.31 秒的平均成绩夺得 [2010 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2010)冠军。[Erik Akkersdijk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005AKKE01)以 10.38 秒获得亚军，[Cornelius Dieckmann](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009DIEC01)以 10.78 秒获得季军。

**世界纪录：**Bálint Bodor：五魔单次 47.53、平均 51.45；Brúnó Bereczki：金字塔单次 2.65。

**欧洲纪录：**Maarten Smit：魔表单次 6.63、平均 7.88；Michal Halczuk：五阶平均 1:15.28；Rafal Guzewicz：多盲 11/11，用时 55:10。
